build_Minecraft_structure: create a Build task to place blocks from a schematic at a given origin in Minecraft
move_agent_to_target: create a Move task to navigate the agent to a target block position using A-star pathfinding
destroy_Minecraft_blocks: create a Destroy task to dig and remove blocks from a given schematic in Minecraft
spawn_Minecraft_mob: create a Spawn task to place a mob entity at a given position using a spawn egg item
pick_up_item: create a Get task to navigate to and pick up an item stack from the ground
